title: The weekly review runs when it is due, even when fwd restarts often
description: The 2026-11-18 build audit found the flow's weekly review had never run on the Owner's Mac: fwd starts it only from a timer that fires after a week of uptime, and fwd had restarted 54 times in 9 days, so the page that says what is working stayed empty. Now fwd checks soon after it starts, and a few times a day after that, whether a review is due: the flow has at least one hunt and review.json is missing or about a week old (FW_REVIEW_EVERY_MS still sets the age). A due review runs as before, with the dial deciding whether shifts apply. A review younger than that is left exactly as it is, so shifts waiting for the Owner are never replaced by a restart.
acceptance: With a hunt and no review.json, a freshly started fwd writes review.json within 20 seconds with no call
With a review 8 days old, a restart replaces it with a new one
With a review 1 day old, a restart leaves the file untouched
A flow with no hunts gets no review written at start
